hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.rs) PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" rustfmt --edition 2021 "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && out=$(PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/rustup/bin:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --all-targets 2>&1 | grep -E '^(warning|error)' | grep -v '^warning: the following packages contain code' | tail -12); if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf 'clippy:\n%s\n' "$out"; fi; true
